name.fr-FR: Opuscules de saint François de Sales, tome XXVI
name.en-US: Opuscules of St. Francis de Sales, vol. XXVI
name.pt-BR: Opúsculos de São Francisco de Sales, tomo XXVI

description.fr-FR: Les opuscules du tome XXVI de l’édition d’Annecy : ascétisme et mystique (Déclaration mystique sur le Cantique des Cantiques, fragments sur les vertus cardinales et sur Notre-Dame, Conseils aux Supérieurs, Similitudes, Avis, lettre sur la prédication).
description.en-US: The opuscules in volume XXVI of the Annecy edition: asceticism and mysticism (the mystical declaration on the Song of Songs, fragments on the cardinal virtues and Our Lady, counsels to superiors, similitudes, advices, the letter on preaching).
description.pt-BR: Os opúsculos de São Francisco de Sales no tomo XXVI da edição de Annecy (Sixième série : Ascétisme et mystique).

sources.edition: Œuvres de saint François de Sales, édition complète d’après les autographes et les éditions originales, t. XXVI: Opuscules, 1929 (file 26), Annecy: J. Niérat, 1892-1932. Scans with text layer (2022 re-OCR) from donboscosanto.eu.
sources.description: Francis’s text in the original spelling (and the Latin or Italian of some pieces), extracted from the PDF text layer (layout mode). Marginal references, the variants and footnotes, and the editors’ introductions and tables are not included. Chapters follow the printed section headings; short sections are folded into the preceding chapter under a second-level heading.
sources.tierEvidence: Francis died in 1622; the Annecy edition is of his own text in period spelling, published in or before 1932. Only Francis’s own text is used, not the editors’ apparatus.
